title: Epub Developer
description:
Job Description for \*ePub Developer\*

\*Job Title: ePub Developer\*

\*Department: ePublishing / Digital Production\*

\*Location: [Madurai]

\*Experience: 1 to 5 Years\*

\*Employment Type: Full-time\*

\*Job Summary:\*

We are looking for a skilled ePub Developer with hands-on experience in creating reflowable and fixed-layout ePubs. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of publishing standards and be able to deliver high-quality, error-free eBooks.

\*Key Responsibilities:\*

- Develop high-quality reflowable and fixed-layout ePubs from InDesign / Word / PDF sources (ePub2 & ePub3)

- Convert and code content using HTML5, CSS3, and XML

- Ensure ePub files meet accessibility standards (WCAG / ePub Accessibility 1.1)

- Perform quality checks using EpubCheck, Ace by DAISY, and other validation tools

- Handle image optimization, font embedding, TOC, metadata creation

- Troubleshoot and fix issues related to rendering across devices (Kindle, Apple Books, Kobo)

- Collaborate with editorial, QC, and project management teams to meet deadlines

- Update work status in internal portal / mVendor

\*Required Skills:\*

- Proven experience in ePub development (ePub2 / ePub3)

- Expert in HTML5, CSS3, XML, XHTML

- Working experience with tools: Adobe InDesign, Oxygen XML Editor, Sigil, Calibre, BBEdit

- Knowledge of WCAG 2.1 / Accessibility, ARIA roles

- Familiarity with Amazon Kindle formats (KF8, KFX)

- Good understanding of ONIX / Metadata is a plus

\*Qualifications:\*

- Any Graduate. Degree/Diploma in Publishing or Computer Science preferred.

- Certification in ePublishing will be an added.

Pay: ₹5,000.00 - ₹12,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
